encoding: Frames are inline: id_hex is the 11-bit arbitration id ((node<<7)|(cmd<<1)|err), rtr marks remote frames, data_hex is the payload (empty string = DLC 0). No .bin files — CAN payloads are at most 8 bytes, so hex-in-manifest keeps each vector self-describing for the Python side.
byte_order: All multi-byte payload fields are BIG-endian; i24/i16/i32 are two's complement; bitfields fold MSB-first (list index 0 = bit 7).
checked_by: crates/par6-bus/tests/golden_can.rs (dir=tx: encode and byte-compare; dir=rx: decode and value-compare; malformed: decode must refuse with the named error)

vectors.name: tx_cmd2_pos_j0
vectors.desc: cmd 2 position mode (DLC 8): pos 1000 ticks, vel -2000 ticks/s, cur 300 mA

vectors.name: tx_cmd2_pos_negative_i24
vectors.desc: cmd 2 position mode with negative i24s: pos -150, vel -187, cur -3047 mA
vectors.derivation: two's-complement i24: -150 -> 2^24-150 = 16777066 = 0xFFFF6A; -187 -> 16777029 = 0xFFFF45; i16: -3047 -> 2^16-3047 = 62489 = 0xF419. Matches the worked example in the vendor Spectral-BLDC CAN_utils (MIT) __main__ block.

vectors.name: tx_cmd2_vel_cur_none_substitutes_zero

vectors.name: tx_cmd2_idle

vectors.name: tx_cmd4_pd

vectors.name: tx_cmd31_hall
vectors.desc: cmd 31 HALL homing pack (DLC 4): i24 speed 12000 ticks/s + trigger byte 2 (any edge); PAR6 J5 hall homing values
vectors.derivation: 12000 = 0x002EE0; trigger_value is a raw byte (0=low level, 1=high level, 2=any edge)

vectors.name: tx_cmd61_gripper
vectors.desc: cmd 61 firmware gripper (DLC 5): position 252, speed 150, current 500 mA, activate+action set (PAR6 homing park move)
vectors.derivation: u8 252 = 0xFC; u8 150 = 0x96; i16 BE 500 = 0x01F4; bitfield [activate,action,estop,release_dir,0,0,0,0] folds MSB-first: activate=bit7, action=bit6 -> 0b11000000 = 0xC0

vectors.name: rx_cmd3_motion_negative
vectors.desc: cmd 3 motion reply (DLC 8): pos -150 ticks, spd -187 ticks/s, cur 3047 mA
vectors.derivation: 0xFFFF6A >= 2^23 so subtract 2^24: 16777066-16777216 = -150; 0xFFFF45 -> -187; 0x0BE7 = 3047. Same bytes as the vendor CAN_utils (MIT) unpack example.

vectors.name: rx_cmd3_motion_err_bit
vectors.desc: cmd 3 motion reply with the arbitration-id err bit SET (live fault): pos 100000, spd -50, cur -300 mA; the err bit must surface on the decode

vectors.name: rx_cmd28_encoder
vectors.desc: cmd 28 encoder reply (DLC 8): i32 pos -123456, i32 spd 2000000

vectors.name: rx_cmd32_hall
vectors.desc: cmd 32 hall reply (DLC 4): latched pos 3969 ticks; trigger and edge set, pin2 clear
vectors.derivation: byte 3 bitfield MSB-first: b7 HALL_trigger=1, b6 pin2=0, b5 hall_index/edge=1 -> 0b10100000 = 0xA0

vectors.name: rx_cmd23_temperature_negative
vectors.desc: cmd 23 temperature reply (DLC 2): i16 -5 degC

vectors.name: rx_cmd24_voltage
vectors.desc: cmd 24 voltage reply (DLC 2): i16 24123 mV

vectors.name: rx_cmd27_iq
vectors.desc: cmd 27 Iq reply (DLC 2): i16 -1200 mA

vectors.name: rx_cmd25_device_info
vectors.desc: cmd 25 device info reply (DLC 7): hw 2, batch 7, sw 14, i32 serial 305419896

vectors.name: rx_cmd26_errors
vectors.desc: cmd 26 error flags reply (DLC 2) with err bit set: error+encoder+estop; calibrated+activated+watchdog

vectors.name: rx_cmd33_kt
vectors.desc: cmd 33 kt reply (DLC 4): f32 BE 0.151 Nm/A (PAR6 J6)

vectors.name: rx_cmd60_gripper
vectors.desc: cmd 60 gripper reply (DLC 4): position 252, current -120 mA (bytes 1..3!), activated, object detection 1 (detected while closing), calibrated
vectors.derivation: byte 3 MSB-first [activated,action_status,od_lo,od_hi,temp_err,timeout_err,estop_err,calibrated] = [1,0,1,0,0,0,0,1] -> 0xA1. Gripper_pack_data fills that array LSB-first (index 2 = value & 1, index 3 = value >> 1) and bitsToByte maps index i onto bit 7-i, so the value's LOW bit is byte bit 5 and its HIGH bit is bit 4: object_detection = (od_hi<<1)|od_lo = (0<<1)|1 = 1

vectors.name: rx_cmd10_ping_reply
vectors.desc: cmd 10 ping reply: a DATA frame with no payload (liveness only)

vectors.name: rx_cmd9_heartbeat
vectors.desc: cmd 9 periodic heartbeat (enabled via cmd 30); no payload
